# `docs` commands

## `docs generate`

Generate the complete command, schema, concepts, and agent-guide documentation tree.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | hub |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | none |
| Capability | none |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | Local only; no HTTP route. |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow docs generate --output docs --check --json`

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `output` | `--output` | string | no | no | "docs" | Directory that receives the complete documentation tree; minimum length 1 |
| `check` | `--check` | boolean | no | no | false | Compare the directory with a fresh render and write nothing |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |

### HTTP

This command has no HTTP route.

### Output

| JSON field | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `output` | string | yes | no | — | Selected documentation directory |
| `mode` | literal["generate", "check"] | yes | no | — | Operation performed |
| `file_count` | integer | yes | no | — | Number of files in the complete documentation tree |
| `files` | array[string] | yes | no | — | Sorted paths relative to the documentation directory |

Example JSON output:

```json
{
  "file_count": 1,
  "files": [],
  "mode": "generate",
  "output": "/example"
}
```

### Errors

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `E_CONTEXT_IN_INPUT` | Input contains a context field. |
| `E_DOCS_STALE` | Generated documentation differs from the current command and schema definitions. |
| `E_INTERNAL` | Internal failure. |
| `E_IO` | A filesystem operation failed. |
| `E_USAGE` | Invalid command syntax. |
| `E_VALIDATION` | Invalid input. |
